title: The Episode About the Khalsa.. U

blocks.text: The split worsens as both sides claim the sangat, but senior voices such as Kahan Singh urge caution so that the fair and congregation are not drowned in mutual destruction.
The page shows that internal Sikh conflict is now dangerous not only spiritually but strategically, because it may expose the whole sangat to Mughal interference.
Kahan Singh anchors the page as one of the main voices trying to restrain collapse.
